payload.summary: A no-op cancellation left row b9f8c826 uncorrected; it needs a fresh update request
payload.detail: During the 2026-08-26 reconciliation (PR #2372), cancel request 224d9a15-49c9-4375-b7bf-563bde1cdccc did not take effect: its target b9f8c826-070f-408b-b700-579117d2414f had already been applied by an earlier reconciliation. ledger-inbox.mjs recorded the cancellation and changed nothing, and it printed the correct remedy -- correct the affected row with a new update request. Nobody has done that yet, so whatever the cancellation intended to undo is still standing in docs/outstanding-issues.md. Work out what row b9f8c826 created, decide whether it should be withdrawn or amended, and issue the corresponding 'npm run issues:update' or 'npm run issues:done' request. Low priority: the ledger is internally consistent and every gate is green; the cost is one stale row, not a broken ledger.
